profit_leakage_findings.title: Duplicate Vendor Invoice Submission (V001-INV-0005)
profit_leakage_findings.historical_comparison: Matches already paid invoice INVREC005 on 2026-06-03 for PO-1030
profit_leakage_findings.explanation: Second submission of identical invoice V001-INV-0005 detected via record INVREC-DUP1. Amount: INR 25,344.38.
profit_leakage_findings.suggested_action: Reject invoice INVREC-DUP1 and issue vendor dispute warning.

profit_leakage_findings.title: Duplicate Equipment Billing (V001-INV-0017)
profit_leakage_findings.historical_comparison: Identical amount matching pending approval record INVREC017
profit_leakage_findings.explanation: Duplicate invoice INVREC-DUP2 submitted for INR 15,448.33 while previous bill is pending in queue.
profit_leakage_findings.suggested_action: Consolidate invoice records and cancel duplicate upload.

profit_leakage_findings.title: Packaging Material Re-submission (V002-INV-0031)
profit_leakage_findings.historical_comparison: Matches PO-1020 previous cycle invoice INVREC031
profit_leakage_findings.explanation: Vendor BrightPack Supplies submitted duplicate claim INVREC-DUP3 for INR 26,886.37.
profit_leakage_findings.suggested_action: Hold disbursement and notify Accounts Payable supervisor.

profit_leakage_findings.title: Inventory Procurement Budget Variance (+₹33,555)
profit_leakage_findings.vendor: Zen Office Tech & Apex Stationery Wholesale
profit_leakage_findings.explanation: Inventory purchases surged above planned threshold due to unnegotiated spot buys.
profit_leakage_findings.suggested_action: Institute bulk discount agreements with primary stationery wholesale vendors.

profit_leakage_findings.title: Overdue Customer Receivables (>30 Days Uncollected)
profit_leakage_findings.historical_comparison: Average DSO slipped from 28 to 44 days
profit_leakage_findings.explanation: Outstanding balances on AR invoices AR-0118 and AR-0125 remain uncollected beyond credit terms.
profit_leakage_findings.suggested_action: Enforce 1.5% monthly late interest penalty and require advance payment on next orders.
